result_text:
The parent landscape report no longer aborts when a sub-landscape has no readable `config.json`. The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, in `addSubLandscapeSection`, around lines 652–658.

The NPE came from `getSubLandscapeConfig`, which returns `null` when the file is missing or unreadable. The caller then called `getMetadata()` on that `null`. Now the caller falls back to `null` metadata and `null` logo, so the existing `else` branch renders the default landscape logo. The row keeps its link to the sub-landscape's index page, the other rows are unchanged, and sub-landscapes with a config still show their own logo.

The reports module compiles offline. There are no existing tests for this generator, so I did not add one. I also did not run a full landscape generation against a broken sub-landscape, so the end-to-end behaviour (generation completing, `updateLandscape` exiting 0) is confirmed by reading the code, not by running it. Nothing was committed.
